camera_height_m: about 0.30 above the book, at Alice's eye-line over her sister's shoulder
angle: looking down at the page, slightly off square so the paper takes no glare
start_frame: POV insert: close grey printed text filling the frame margin to margin, the sister's thumb holding the outer edge, no illustration and no drop cap anywhere in the page.
end_frame: The identical frame at the end of the three seconds — the page has not been turned and nothing has been revealed; the emptiness is the answer.
constraint_honoured: 'Frame filled edge to edge with grey type' — a locked square-ish insert is the only way the page reads as a page and stays legibly pictureless.
movement_note: POV 1 of 7, on the human-eye lens; 3.0 s is a single clean read and far too short to carry any move.
